analyst.summary: Heritage Foods is a South India dairy processor. FY26 revenue grew to Rs.4,526 Cr, but the operating margin -- always thin in dairy -- compressed further to 4.6% in the most recent quarter from 7% two quarters earlier, driven by raw milk cost pressure that the company could not fully pass through. The stock trades around 23-24 times earnings, which is a full price for a low-single-digit-margin commodity business showing margin pressure rather than margin expansion. We do not see a case for holding this above a Sell rating at current levels.
